name: github
description: Local git history and diff helpers for a GitHub repo. The sandbox blocks network, so GitHub itself is not reachable.

skills.name: Commit message
skills.instructions: Write a commit message for the current changes. First call git_status and git_diff. Then run git diff --staged --stat with run_command, or git diff --stat if nothing is staged. Use a short imperative subject under 72 characters, and add a body only if the change needs explaining. Do not commit.

skills.name: Recent history
skills.instructions: Summarize recent work. Run git log --oneline -20 with run_command, group the commits by theme, and name the main files they touched.

skills.name: PR description
skills.instructions: Write a pull request description for the current branch. Run git branch --show-current, git log --oneline main..HEAD, and git diff --stat main...HEAD with run_command. Give a summary, a list of changes, and how to test. Do not try to open the PR, because GitHub is not reachable from the sandbox.
